## Phase: 63 - Harness Assessment & Eval-Validity

### Eval-validity is the spine
from: [[decision:eval-validity-instrument-sensitivity-probe]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- Net-zero is AMBIGUOUS: worthless feature vs blind instrument — undecidable from the number alone. The 58/59/61 cuts all rode on net-zeros from an apparatus `eval/comparison/methodology.md` itself flags as N=1, self-graded, capability-gap-confounded, Python-only.
- An instrument-sensitivity probe (inject known-good + known-broken, confirm a non-zero delta) must precede ANY cut-by-eval. If blind → STOP cut-by-eval, pivot to the eval proposal; that finding IS the apparatus verdict. Deterministic `make eval` (binary, 54) is likely sensitive; the LLM-judge reasoning/comparison evals are the suspects.

### Classification rigor (no false-deadweight)
from: [[decision:deadweight-requires-affirmative-evidence]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- DEADWEIGHT needs affirmative evidence — a firing test (synthesize the trigger, assert exit+side-effect) OR ablation delta≈0; NEVER loadedness, NEVER log-absence ("verify firing, never just file presence" — inverse: absence ≠ deadweight; long-cadence hooks fire rarely). Separate activation from causal influence. `uses` counter is inert (87/100 at the floor) — not the cut signal.
- Cognitive system (12 HEU + 5 IRON all helpful:0/harmful:0, never fired): cut-vs-fix turns on whether a cheap wired path to firing exists (one-line counter bug → fix) or it's structurally never-reached (→ cut the scaffolding). When a layer is down to its last leaf, subtract the SCAFFOLDING (matcher/judge/dashboard), not the leaf.

### Cuts are frozen, batched migrations
from: [[decision:cuts-are-frozen-batched-migrations]] | [[decision:roadmap-decidable-when]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- Run the 4-angle pass over a FROZEN harness state; batch cuts at the end (findings must not be measured against a world still containing the thing being removed — assessor=assessed). Every templates/ deletion ships via `cp -r` to every project (cascade-failure bitten 3×) ⇒ quarantine-first migration; after cuts, test_registration.sh + referential-integrity + make test ≥13 + make eval 54 must all pass or the cut reverts to the roadmap.
- Break the 58/59/61 stuck cycle: every deferred roadmap item carries a canonical `decidable-when:` line (the observable that resolves it); item count must equal `decidable-when:` count.
